use.title: Welcome, valued demographic!
use.text: The showroom is closed for staff training. You may still WANT things.

options.label: What is on offer?
options.result: Everything you can see. Nothing you can afford. That is the brand.

options.label: Ask for a sample
options.result: A sample has been dispensed to your account.

use.title: This season: WANT
use.text:
WANT MORE. WORK MORE. BE MORE.

Staff are reminded that wanting is for customers.

use.title: STAFF ONLY
use.text:
Breaks are fifteen minutes.

Everything on this floor is off duty. Talk to it (E). Ask it to show you what it does: what can walk goes to the gun range, east off the spine; what cannot has a target where it stands.

The blue card is in a locker in the Locker Room. The red card is in the Vault, behind the blue door. The way out is behind the red one, north-east.
Two of the night shift. They were asleep.

use.title: Who is shooting?
use.text:
Pick somebody. The nearest one of that kind that is free walks to the range, shows what it does for a few seconds, and goes back to where it was.

You can also ask any of them yourself (E).
